intro: A cooking contest: the people on the show, the rounds, the scores and the path from semifinal to prize.

el jurado.en: the jury; the panel of judges

bloques.titulo: From the first round to the prize
bloques.texto:
**The contest.** **Un concurso** has **concursantes**, **un jurado**, **un presentador** or **una presentadora** and **un premio**. The stages are **la prueba**, **la semifinal** and **la final**. Also **un reto** (a challenge) and **un ensayo** (a rehearsal). The people: **el ganador**, **el finalista**, **el favorito**, **el aficionado**.

**The cooking.** Each contestant follows **una receta** and prepares **un plato** or **un postre**. The jury tastes it and gives **una puntuación**.

**The results.** A contestant **gana**, **empata** or **queda eliminado**. **El empate** means two people have the same score. **La clasificación** shows who is ahead.

**The end.** The host announces **al ganador**. He is **premiado con** un viaje or **eliminado** in the semifinal. He can ask to **repetir** la prueba.

**Prepositions.** **Premiar con** un viaje. **Clasificarse para** la final. **Ganar por** un punto. **Ser el favorito de** la gente.

**The passive of the news.** **Fue elegido** ayer. **Ha sido premiada**. **Será anunciado** en mayo.

**False friends.** **La prueba** is a round or a test, and also proof. **El premio** is a prize; a price is **el precio**.

bloques.titulo: The final of the cooking contest

frases.es: Tres años después de la primera edición, ayer empezó por fin la final del concurso.
frases.en: Three years after the first edition, the final of the contest finally began yesterday.
analisis: Tres años después de la primera edición

frases.es: El concursante, de cuarenta y dos años, fue elegido finalista una semana después de la semifinal gracias a una receta inventada por su abuela.
frases.en: The contestant, aged forty-two, was chosen as a finalist a week after the semifinal thanks to a recipe invented by his grandmother.
analisis: una semana después de la semifinal

frases.es: Él cuenta que está muy tranquilo y que la noche anterior estaba ensayando el plato con su hermano.
frases.en: He says he is very calm and that the night before he was rehearsing the dish with his brother.

frases.es: El jurado, sin embargo, considera que el postre no se sostiene, puesto que se hunde al cortarlo.
frases.en: The jury, however, considers that the dessert does not hold its shape, since it collapses when cut.

frases.es: La presentadora del programa, que fue aplaudida y felicitada, declaró que no podía elegir un favorito porque todos los platos estaban deliciosos.
frases.en: The host of the programme, who was applauded and congratulated, said she could not choose a favourite because all the dishes were delicious.

frases.es: El otro finalista pide que se repita la prueba del postre, ya que el horno había fallado durante el primer intento.
frases.en: The other finalist is asking for the dessert round to be repeated, since the oven had failed during the first attempt.

frases.es: Si el jurado lo declara ganador, podría ser premiado con un viaje a Italia.
frases.en: If the jury declares him the winner, he could be awarded a trip to Italy.
analisis: Si el jurado lo declara ganador

bloques.pregunta: According to the text, what made him a finalist?

opciones.A recipe invented by his grandmother: Gracias a una receta inventada por su abuela.
opciones.A draw by luck: The text mentions the recipe, not a draw.
opciones.A tip from the host: The host did not choose him; the recipe did.

bloques.correcta: A recipe invented by his grandmother

bloques.pregunta: According to the text, why does the other finalist want the dessert round repeated?

opciones.The oven had failed in the first attempt: El horno había fallado durante el primer intento.
opciones.He was ill that day: Illness is a distractor; the reason is the oven.
opciones.The dessert was too sweet: Sweetness is a distractor; he blames the oven.

bloques.correcta: The oven had failed in the first attempt

bloques.pregunta: The panel that tastes and scores the dishes is…

opciones.el jurado: The jury tastes the dishes and gives the scores.
opciones.el aficionado: A fan follows the contest from outside.

bloques.pregunta: Complete: he was awarded a trip.

opciones.con: Premiar con means to award with, so con is the right preposition.
opciones.a: Premiar does not take a before the prize.
opciones.por: Por gives the reason: premiado por su receta.

bloques.pregunta: A practice run before the real performance is…

opciones.un ensayo: Un ensayo is a rehearsal: practice before the real thing.
opciones.un premio: That is what the winner receives.

opciones.explicacion: Fue eliminado means he was knocked out of the contest.

bloques.frase: El jurado eligió a dos finalistas ayer por la tarde
bloques.traduccion: The jury chose two finalists yesterday afternoon.

bloques.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write the newspaper report of a contest, real or invented: the facts, the scores and the position of each finalist.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Give your opinion aloud on a question about contests, such as whether competing helps people to improve.
